title: Megurine Luka — Being There〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Band me seemed to have quite a lot of fun again today. Now, which SEKAI should I look at next...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
Miku and the others said that they'd be taking a look at some as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Luka was so cute.
Just looking at her made me smile.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That was a bit of a rare spectacle.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'm very glad we decided to go take a look.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I just heard my name, but what could they be talking about...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What were you three talking about just now?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-You said that you'd be taking a look at one of the other SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha. Sooner than we expected.
So, how much did you hear just now...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I heard you all mention my name, and when Miku said, “Just looking at her made me smile.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But it felt rude of me to eavesdrop, so I decided to come see what was going on...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Well, this is embarrassing...
We weren't expecting you to overhear us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. But it's not meant to be a secret or anything either...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, we just went to take a look at one of the other SEKAI. Remember the one where I'm running a cafe?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
We just happened to catch Luka cooking with MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, the carrots are all peeled.
I need you to cut these into quarter slices.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And make sure to curl up your fingers so that it looks like a cat's paw.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Umm...
You don't need to talk like a cat.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Were you trying to say, “Isn't this cute?”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you...
Yes, that's cute, but promise me that you'll stay focused when you do cut these.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The me from that SEKAI really is interesting. I mean, she's such a free spirit. It's hard to tell what she's going to do next.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To the point where even MEIKO, despite being so cool and collected, has trouble dealing with her antics sometimes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That reminds me...!
Idol Luka was also incredibly cute.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Phew...
Let's take a break here, shall we?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry, Miku, but do you have a minute to check over something regarding our practice with Minori and the others tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay♪
I'll be right back, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know I'm supposed to be taking a break, but it's hard not to feel bored...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... From this angle, only Miku should be able to see me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka, I'm having trouble paying attention to what he's saying.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? I'm just massaging my cheeks.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You should be lishening to what KAITO is shaying.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, it sounds like that me is as mischievous as ever.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, what she did was very cute and even put smiles on all of our faces.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, it's amazing how soft that Luka's cheeks are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I mean, they stretch so much...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What an adorable skill.
Actually, I might see if I can do the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, in that case... Let's have a contest to see whose cheeks can stretch out the farthest.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Great idea! We should also invite Rin and Len!
